name: mysql-persistent
description: MySQL 8.0 with automatic backups to persistent storage

scripts.setup:
# MySQL will use native Linux filesystem for data (better permission support)
# Volume is used for backups accessible from Windows

# Initialize MySQL if needed
if [ ! -d "/var/lib/mysql/mysql" ]; then
  echo "Initializing MySQL database..."
  mysqld --initialize-insecure --user=mysql --datadir=/var/lib/mysql
fi

# Configure MySQL to bind all interfaces
sed -i 's/bind-address.*/bind-address = 0.0.0.0/' /etc/mysql/mysql.conf.d/mysqld.cnf || true

# Start MySQL
service mysql start

# Wait for MySQL to be ready
echo "Waiting for MySQL to start..."
for i in {1..30}; do
  if mysqladmin ping -h localhost --silent 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "MySQL is ready!"
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done

# Set root password and create dev user
# First try with auth_socket (sudo), then with password
mysql -u root <<MYSQL_SCRIPT
ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED WITH mysql_native_password BY 'devpassword';
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'dev'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'devpassword';
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'dev'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'devpassword';
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON *.* TO 'dev'@'%' WITH GRANT OPTION;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON *.* TO 'dev'@'localhost' WITH GRANT OPTION;
FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
MYSQL_SCRIPT

echo "MySQL users configured"

# Check if backup exists and restore it
if [ -f /mnt/mysql-backups/all_databases_latest.sql ]; then
  echo "Restoring from backup..."
  mysql -u root -pdevpassword < /mnt/mysql-backups/all_databases_latest.sql 2>/dev/null || echo "Note: Backup restore attempted"
fi

# Create backup script
cat > /mnt/mysql-backups/backup.sh << 'BACKUP_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# MySQL Backup Script
BACKUP_DIR="/mnt/mysql-backups"
DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

# Create archives directory
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR/archives"

# Backup all databases (redirect stderr to avoid password warning in SQL)
mysqldump -u root -pdevpassword --all-databases --single-transaction --routines --triggers 2>/dev/null > "$BACKUP_DIR/all_databases_$DATE.sql"

# Create latest symlink
rm -f "$BACKUP_DIR/all_databases_latest.sql"
ln -s "all_databases_$DATE.sql" "$BACKUP_DIR/all_databases_latest.sql"

# Move old backups to archives (keep last 5)
find "$BACKUP_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name "all_databases_*.sql" -type f | sort -r | tail -n +6 | xargs -I {} mv {} "$BACKUP_DIR/archives/" 2>/dev/null

echo "Backup completed: $DATE"
echo "Location: $BACKUP_DIR/all_databases_$DATE.sql"
BACKUP_EOF

chmod +x /mnt/mysql-backups/backup.sh

# Create initial backup
echo "Creating initial backup..."
/mnt/mysql-backups/backup.sh

echo ""
echo "=============================================="
echo "MySQL 8.0 Ready!"
echo "=============================================="
echo "Root Password: devpassword"
echo "Dev User: dev / devpassword"
echo ""
echo "Connect as root: mysql -u root -pdevpassword"
echo "Connect as dev:  mysql -u dev -pdevpassword"
echo "Connect from host: mysql -h localhost -P 3306 -u dev -pdevpassword"
echo ""
echo "Backups located: /mnt/mysql-backups/"
echo "  (accessible from Windows Explorer)"
echo ""
echo "Create backup: /mnt/mysql-backups/backup.sh"
echo "Restore: mysql -u root -pdevpassword < /mnt/mysql-backups/all_databases_latest.sql"
echo "=============================================="
